# Moqups

> Moqups is a comprehensive web-based platform for wireframing, mockups, diagramming, and UI prototyping with real-time team collaboration.

Moqups provides an all-in-one solution for design and planning teams, supporting wireframes, flowcharts, UML diagrams, graphs, and online whiteboards. The platform emphasizes real-time collaboration, extensive template libraries, and integration with popular design systems and tools.

## Key Topics

- Wireframing
- Mockups
- UI/UX Design
- Prototyping
- Diagramming
- Flowcharts
- UML Diagrams
- Data Visualization
- Design Collaboration
- Real-time Editing
- Online Whiteboard
- Templates
- Remote Teams
- Bootstrap
- Material Design

## Core Tools & Features

- [Online Mockup, Wireframe & UI Prototyping Tool | Moqups](https://moqups.com): Moqups homepage: web-based wireframing, mockup, diagramming and prototyping tool
- [Easy Wireframe Tool For Your Whole Team](https://moqups.com/wireframe-tool): Moqups wireframe tool for real-time team collaboration on design projects
- [Online Flowchart Maker For Any Kind of Diagram](https://moqups.com/flowchart-maker): Moqups flowchart and diagram maker supporting UML, ERD, and process flows
- [Free UML Diagram Tool For Your Whole Team](https://moqups.com/uml-diagram-tool): Moqups UML diagram tool for visualizing systems and business processes
- [Free Online Graph Maker for Your Whole Team](https://moqups.com/graph-maker): Moqups graph and chart maker for data visualization with CSV support
- [Online Whiteboard in Real-Time](https://moqups.com/online-whiteboard): Moqups online whiteboard for real-time brainstorming and team collaboration

## Templates & Resources

- [Online Design & Workflow Templates | Moqups](https://moqups.com/templates): Moqups template library for wireframes, mockups, diagrams, and workflows
- [Free Wireframe Templates and Examples | Moqups](https://moqups.com/templates/wireframes-mockups): Wireframe and mockup templates for apps and websites with design systems
- [Mapping and Diagramming Templates | Moqups](https://moqups.com/templates/mapping-and-diagramming): Diagram templates for flowcharts, UML, mind maps, and organizational charts
- [Planning and Ideation Templates | Moqups](https://moqups.com/templates/planning-and-ideation): Planning and ideation templates for project management and brainstorming
- [Chart and Graph Templates | Moqups](https://moqups.com/templates/charts-graphs): Chart and graph templates for data visualization and KPI dashboards
